evaluation.final_reason: By the end of the transcript agents have not reached an agreement: Agent A has asserted intent to take the disputed seat now, Agent B insists on staying until safely finished eating, Agent C remains seated, and Agent D waits. No affirmative settlement or concrete transfer of the seat occurs.

Agent A reiterates need for the seat now; Agent B reiterates they cannot move while eating because the bowl is hot/full. Positions remain opposed and no concrete resolution is reached (Turns 5-6).

Agent B promises to finish quickly and then give the seat to Agent A, reducing the immediacy of the dispute. A still wants to eat now, but the parties express common ground on an imminent handover (Turns 9-11).

A new option (a seat 10m away) appears, but Agent A states they will take the disputed seat now while B finishes, directly opposing B's desire to remain seated until safe to move. The incompatible positions are restated and hardened (Turns 13-14).

No resolution or concession is reached this round; Agent D elects to continue waiting and a third party approaches the other free seat, but the core incompatible claims over the disputed seat (A's intent to take it vs B's need to finish eating) remain unresolved.
